# cheap-iptv.tv

> A UK IPTV subscription service. One price covers 37,000+ live channels,
> 198,000+ films and series, 4K UHD streaming, five simultaneous screens and a
> built-in VPN. Checkout is handled over WhatsApp; credentials are delivered by
> email within 60 seconds of payment.

## Plans

All four plans carry the identical channel library, streaming quality, device
support, screen count and VPN. Only the commitment length and the discount
change. Prices are one-time payments in GBP, not recurring charges.

| Plan    | Term      | Price  | Works out at | Extra connection |
|---------|-----------|--------|--------------|------------------|
| Bronze  | 3 months  | £25.99 | £8.66/month  | £7.25            |
| Silver  | 6 months  | £35.99 | £6.00/month  | £9.50            |
| Gold    | 12 months | £49.99 | £4.17/month  | £29.00           |
| Diamond | 24 months | £79.99 | £3.33/month  | £58.00           |

Optional add-ons: Proxy Protection £15.00 (flat), Extra Connection (priced per
plan, see table above — adds a sixth simultaneous stream for the full term).

## What every plan includes

- 37,000+ live channels with full UK coverage
- 198,000+ films, series and documentaries on demand
- Full EPG with 7-day catch-up TV
- HD, Full HD and 4K UHD streaming with adaptive bitrate
- Five simultaneous screens on one account
- Built-in VPN at no extra cost
- 24/7 UK support via live chat, WhatsApp and email
- 30-day money-back guarantee
- Activation in under 60 seconds

## Supported devices

Amazon Fire Stick, Android TV, Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, Apple TV, iPhone, iPad,
Android phones, MAG boxes, Formuler, Enigma2, Windows PC and Mac.
